notablePrerequisites: Barrage Ogre does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Barrage Ogre by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Barrage Orge ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.
